Hannah / Marissa —

Draft canary checklist (high level):
- Pre-flight (48–24h): verify SSO tokens, KMS keys, infra peering, export baseline prompts + expected token counts.
- Day 0 (start, May 5): deploy canary variant to canary pool, route 5% traffic. Smoke test 1: token throughput at nominal load.
- 24h gate: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 420ms, error rate < 0.2% (metrics captured in Redwood Console).
- 48h gate: increase to 25% if health gates pass; run subset of regression prompt set and compare generation quality score (eval harness).
- Rollback: immediate rollback to baseline if p95 spike > 2x or quality delta > 6 pts on eval harness.

Migration cutover (weeks 3–4):
- Stage 1: region A 50% (safety period 12h)
- Stage 2: region B 100% (monitoring 24h)
- Finalize: decommission old routing after 72h stable

Training outline (90m):
- 0–15m: intro & architecture overview (serving runtime, routing, cache behavior)
- 15–45m: integration patterns (client side retry/backoff, streaming handlers)
- 45–70m: incident scenarios & troubleshooting (KV cache, OOMs, throttling)
- 70–90m: hands-on checklist + Q&A

Attachments: canary-checklist.pdf (application/pdf) — includes runbook and Grafana dashboards to watch

I’ll prepare the runbooks and a short Grafana dashboard pack. Marissa — can you confirm PS attendance and training materials? Jordan — I’ll post the runbook to the shared Drive after your EOD confirmation of the third observer.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
